premium.basis: November 24, 2017 close of $10.55, last trading day before Transaction Committee authorized proceeding at $18.00

value_inflection_events.event: Bloomberg story leak / pre-announcement trading ahead of December 7 article
Bloomberg article published December 7 reporting Sucampo considering a sale

leaked_early.details: Bloomberg article published December 7, 2017 (19 days before announcement), no earlier leaks identified

notes: Mallinckrodt initiated a bilateral negotiation leading to an all-cash $18.00 per share tender offer at a 70.6% premium; prior unsolicited approaches had failed and the board declined to run a broader auction after a Bloomberg leak in December 2017 yielded no inbound interest.
